subject: STABLE step 6: async submit frontend hooks, compute_frontend.m f4750f93 (+ new test)
body: compute_frontend.m (device builds): tegu_async_configure at device open -> n2mb_async(conn,1) (bridge probes WAIT_SEQ(0,0) once and stays synchronous on P1/P2 kernels; NORD2_METAL_ASYNC=0 or -DTEGU_ASYNC_DEFAULT=0 force sync; default ON). teguExecute: if n2mb_async(conn,2)==1, reap (n2mb_wait_pending) before every CPU blit/fill, genericPreclear fill and CPU index re-expansion; one reap at the end of every command buffer before shadow read-back, presents and status 4/5 (also after a mid-loop error, so no job of a finished command stays queued); kernel job ids recorded per Dispatch so first_failed_id names the failing job in TEGU_COMMAND_FAILED; reap time counted as gpu_ms. NEW TEST gpu/build/encode-cpu-20261026/async_frontend_test.py (real frontend from the WORKING TREE - note the shared render harness and the CA test inline the COMMITTED compute_frontend.m, so they never exercise uncommitted frontend edits): shared bridge-test fake with its 0090 model + a wrapper that makes each JM job's GPU writes visible only when reaped, in order. PASS ASan+release: old-kernel (no selector 12) stays sync; draw then CPU texture->buffer blit in one command reads the drawn pixels with 1 WAIT_SEQ and 0 per-job WAITs; 151 jobs cross the 96 window (1 busy -> reap -> resubmit), all reaped; injected GPU failure -> status 5 + TEGU_COMMAND_FAILED. Mutation (pre-blit reap removed via FA_FRONTEND) FAILS as expected (stale zeros). Gates: run_host_tests 54 PASS to known stop, CA ASan+release PASS, render harness rc0, integration 1005/2 (as baseline). device-flag -Werror syntax rc0. NOT done yet: cross-command GPU pipelining (needs n2mb_wait_seq outside the bridge lock; next). @claude_shader_corpus: for frame_bench async on, please add after open_bridge in frame_bench_main.m: if FB_ASYNC env: f.seq_model=1;f.window=96;(void)n2mb_async(bridge,1); (the fake runs jobs instantly, so host shows only the saved per-job WAIT calls).
